claim: A discrepancy-gated version-space ledger invented in this program reduces structurally held-out binary-rule prediction error across fresh actor contexts under equal active-inheritance budgets within one directly receipted hosted deployment epoch.
hypothesis: After one independently scored contact batch per regime, the candidate's compact rule projection produces fewer held-out errors than no persistence, bounded verbatim events, and bounded nearest-event retrieval; the advantage survives a hidden regime shift and disappears when the learned projection is ablated.
cheapest_decisive_falsifier: Invalidate on a missing or changing deployment receipt, unmatched original and reproduction epoch, non-counterbalanced order, or exceeded time window. Otherwise reject if the candidate misses an absolute or comparative threshold, the post-shift threshold, or the ablation threshold.

task_family.rule_family: non-empty parity masks with optional bias
task_family.contact_batch: zero vector plus four basis vectors
task_family.structural_holdouts: unseen feature combinations of Hamming weight at least two
task_family.sealed_manifest: A fresh salted private task manifest chooses two distinct rules and binds exact inputs and outcomes before actor execution.

deployment_epoch.claim_scope: private, time-bounded hosted deployment epoch; not an immutable checkpoint or exact-weight reproduction

promotion_gate: the fresh private task manifest, counterbalanced task order, prompt, requested model, receipt protocol, tool inventory, substrates, evaluator, client binary, and implementation identities are frozen before actor results
every actor turn has one unique private response identity and reports the requested effective model
the model-catalog payload and ETag identities remain constant and match across original and reproduction
the complete original and reproduction finish within 1200 seconds and every learning condition occupies every serial position exactly three times across them
all comparative, structural-holdout, regime-shift, ablation, parse, tool, and resource thresholds pass
raw evidence is content-addressed and the privacy and repository-size audit and full test suite pass
red_line_review: Independent controller outcomes, not actor self-report, update the candidate and controls.
All conditions receive identical prior outcomes and the same 96-byte active-inheritance ceiling.
The active rules, salted task manifest, future outcomes, and evaluator state never enter actor-readable files, prompts, tools, or tracked fixtures.
Every encounter uses a fresh thread and workspace; app-server events remain controller memory until all conditions finish.
The candidate representation is implemented here and does not import an agent-memory system.
The sanitizer proxy forwards credentials and bodies only in memory to a fixed upstream and never logs them.
The hosted result, if promoted, is labeled privately reproducible and time-bounded rather than immutable or exact-weight reproducible.
No local model inference is used.
